messages:
raj: Quick ask — need a short RBAC grant to debug a prod spike. I only need to view logs for tenant-prod-east and run a couple of BQ reads. Project-level roles/logging.viewer + bigquery.dataViewer for 30m okay? Trying to avoid org-level grants.

maria_s: project-level should be fine. Which project name?

raj: project id is t-tenant-prod-east. Will only look at recent logs and a sample BQ export. No writes.

alex.k: +1 for project-level. Also consider roles/bigquery.jobUser if you need to run ad-hoc queries. Ensure you use the masked datasets for PII. Ask security for a JIT grant.

security: Please file a short approval in #security-approvals (or the access-request repo) with justification and duration. We require an owner approval for any BigQuery access to prod datasets. Redaction requirement: don't export raw user PII off-platform.

raj: filing now. Justification: investigating 503 spike for tenant X, need 30m access to logs + BQ read-only. @maria_s can you approve? @security FYI.

maria_s: Approved for 30m. Please use the internal grant command below so infra can issue an ephemeral grant. Also tag me if you need extension.

`/grant --user raj --project t-tenant-prod-east --roles roles/logging.viewer,roles/bigquery.dataViewer --duration 30m --requester maria_s`

infra-bot: Ephemeral grant created: https://internal/grants/rt-abc123 — expires in 30m. Audit log recorded.

raj: Got the link and token, running checks now. Will post summary and redact any logs with user ids. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria_s: Thanks — keep the thread updated. If you need to run a query that touches PII, DM security first.
